task_title: QA filing: docs/ACCEPTANCE-PLAN.md is stale by one selftest section (§30) and the CF-099 drift probe exits 1 at HEAD
task_criteria:
This task grades a QA FILING, not the underlying fix. Do not evaluate whether the documented drift is repaired; the filed row is pending by definition.

1. The filing commit in the graded tree changes exactly .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl and .coding-hermes/board/events.jsonl (plus nothing else): `git show --stat <commit>` lists only board files. State the stat.
2. The committed board carries a row whose title begins `P4 — docs/ACCEPTANCE-PLAN.md still states 29 selftest sections` exactly once (`git show <commit>:.coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl | grep -c 'still states 29 selftest sections'` prints 1), the row's `status` is `pending`, and its `probe` field is non-empty.
3. Extract that probe from the COMMITTED tree and run it from the repo root: `git show <commit>:.coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl | jq -r 'select(.id=="<row>").probe' > /tmp/p.sh; bash /tmp/p.sh` prints, in order: `30`; a line `7:29 sections — plus two lettered sub-arms`; a line `61:`d02916e`, `tests/selftest.sh` has 29 numbered sections`; `DRIFT: plan says 29 sections, tests/selftest.sh has 30`; `probe_rc=1`. Paste the verbatim output.
4. The committed row's id matches `^CF-[0-9]{3}$`, is unique in the committed board (`jq -r .id | sort | uniq -d` prints nothing), and the board line count equals the pre-filing count plus 1.
5. The same committed board reformatted as JSONL parses (`.coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl` every line `jq -c .` rc 0) and `bash scripts/boardctl validate` prints `RESULT: OK`.
6. The row's `reasoning` field names both commits that make the drift (`1b4b0b6` added §30, `c9848d7` reconciled the snapshot without updating the count) and states the dedupe boundary against CF-113, CF-115 and CF-121.

Pass only if the probe reproduces the exact output in leg 3 from the committed board text. A row id named without its re-runnable command is not evidence.
